ns2:course.label: Adv Small Animal Dentistry
ns2:course.description: The recognition and appropriate treatment of various types of feline and canine dental diseases will be discussed. The laboratories will be utilized to assist students in the determination of the appropriate diagnosis based on dental radiographs, photographs and models. Oral surgery, periodontic and endodontic therapy will also be performed in the laboratory. 1 graduate or professional hour. Approved for S/U grading only. Prerequisite: VCM 652.
